memory_annotations.evidence_summary: Avery established trip-specific constraints for one exhibition-opening journey: Tuesday arrival in Chicago by 11:00 a.m., economy travel for one person, and an unresolved Friday departure after a post-opening handoff. messages.content: I need a round trip from Atlanta to Chicago for an exhibition installation, leaving Tuesday, April 14, and returning Friday, April 17. It is just me, in economy. I have to be at the museum by 1:00 Tuesday afternoon, so the arrival time is firm. Friday is less settled because I do not know when the post-opening handoff will finish.
Understood. For Tuesday, what time do you need to allow for getting from the airport to the museum? Also, are both O'Hare and Midway acceptable?
The museum is downtown. I would like to be on the ground by 11:00 a.m. so I have a reasonable buffer. Either airport is fine.

I found three nonstop Tuesday options that meet that cutoff. Times are local:

- Delta: Atlanta 7:10 a.m. to O'Hare 8:25 a.m., round trip from $318
- United: Atlanta 8:05 a.m. to O'Hare 9:22 a.m., round trip from $301
- Southwest: Atlanta 8:20 a.m. to Midway 9:15 a.m., round trip from $286

The Midway flight gives you the shortest trip into downtown and still leaves nearly four hours before the handoff. The fares depend on which Friday return you pair with it.
The Southwest flight looks practical. Is it nonstop, and is that fare the regular economy option rather than something with a connection hidden in it?

Yes. It is nonstop from ATL to MDW, scheduled for 1 hour 55 minutes. The quoted fare is Southwest's lowest standard fare currently shown; it includes two checked bags, but the ticket is not refundable to your original payment method if you cancel.
Keep that as the leading outbound. I am not ready to purchase until Friday is clearer. What return flights are available after the opening?

What is the earliest plausible time you could leave the museum Friday, and how late are you willing to arrive in Atlanta? That will determine whether an early-evening flight is realistic or whether I should focus on the last departures.

The public program ends at 5:00 p.m., but the handoff might take one or two hours after that. Please show me something around 7:30, something around 9:00, and the latest sensible nonstop. I know the first one may be too tight.

Here are three nonstop Friday returns worth tracking:

- Southwest: Midway 7:35 p.m. to Atlanta 10:25 p.m.; paired total $286
- Delta: O'Hare 8:55 p.m. to Atlanta 11:58 p.m.; paired total $336 if the outbound remains Southwest
- United: O'Hare 9:40 p.m. to Atlanta 12:44 a.m. Saturday; paired total $329 with the Southwest outbound

The 7:35 departure would require leaving downtown at roughly 5:30 to allow a reasonable airport buffer, so it does not fit a handoff that runs until 6:00 or 7:00. The two O'Hare options provide more working time, although the 8:55 flight could still be uncomfortable if you finish at 7:00.
Is there a later Midway flight? Switching airports between the two legs is fine since I will not have a car.

The 7:35 p.m. Southwest departure is the last nonstop from Midway to Atlanta that Friday. There is a 9:10 p.m. itinerary, but it connects in Nashville and reaches Atlanta at 12:35 a.m. Its total travel time is longer than the 9:40 p.m. nonstop from O'Hare, so it offers no real advantage unless the O'Hare fare rises sharply.
Agreed. Keep the 8:55 Delta and 9:40 United returns on the list. Can you also check what happens if I take United both ways instead of mixing airlines?

Pairing the Tuesday 8:05 a.m. United outbound with the Friday 9:40 p.m. United return is currently $301 round trip. That is $28 less than combining Southwest outbound with United return. You would arrive at O'Hare at 9:22 Tuesday, which still meets your 11:00 a.m. arrival cutoff, though the trip downtown is generally longer than from Midway.
Then the all-United itinerary may be the better value. I still want the Southwest outbound noted because Midway is convenient, but do not book either. I should know the handoff time tomorrow.

I have the working shortlist as follows:

- Leading complete itinerary: United nonstop, ATL 8:05 a.m. to ORD 9:22 a.m. Tuesday; ORD 9:40 p.m. to ATL 12:44 a.m. Saturday; currently $301 round trip
- Alternate outbound: Southwest nonstop, ATL 8:20 a.m. to MDW 9:15 a.m. Tuesday
- Alternate return: Delta nonstop, ORD 8:55 p.m. to ATL 11:58 p.m. Friday

Nothing has been booked or held, and fares and seats can change. Once the museum confirms the Friday finish time, we can choose between the 8:55 and 9:40 returns and recheck the totals.
